usedFor: OnePage CRM runs sales as a to-do list, with “Create Deal”, “Create Note” and “Create Action” adding next steps.

bestTemplate.name: “New Booking Created” in Recras, then “Create Contact hold” in OnePage CRM
bestTemplate.why: A new booking adds the person as a contact, so a sales follow-up can start.

watchOut: “Update Deal” in OnePage CRM changes a specific deal, so an earlier step must pass which one.
